title: Hello World!!!
excerpt: Seven years, a marketplace idea, a Pokémon TCG store and now a little corner of the internet. Welcome to PSRMalam.

body.text: Welcome to my first blog post on PSRMalam.

This whole idea of having my own blog has been on my mind for a while now. And ngl, it is also partly because i have been paying for the PSRMalam domain for the past (checks calendar) seven-ish years without putting it to consistent use.

Yes, PSRMalam started back in 2019, when i first graduated from Temasek Poly. My initial plan was to build a marketplace for curated local products, hence the name. It eventually morphed into a Pokémon TCG store in 2024 while i was tinkering around in my free time. This was not sustainable because i love ripping packs too much, and keeping sealed products near me was pretty much torture lmao.

So here we are, seven years on, with PSRMalam in its final iteration: a little safe corner of the internet where friends, family and you can keep up with my nonsense, whether it is about work, hobbies or just pure yapping.
You will probably see a mix of posts covering a few recurring themes:

items: My work on InsourceAI, GoldenWax and Cream.
Tracking my comic book and Pokémon card collections.
Keeping up with my running schedule and seeing if i can eventually complete a full marathon.
Stuff i have been researching and learning about, mostly AI and the like.
Religion. Yes, surprise surprise, the prodigal son returns after ten years away from church.

body.text: Anyway, i hope to post consistently and keep things interesting. i will probably yap a lot and wander off topic once in a while, so please bear with me. i will try to stay on track, but no promises.
Hope you enjoy hanging out in my little corner of the internet.

body.alt: A playful, slightly blurry selfie of Jae wearing earbuds and a backpack.
